scripts.dev: concurrently --prefix-colors 'cyan,magenta' "cd packages/api && bun run dev" "cd packages/ui && bun run dev"
scripts.setup: bun install && cd packages/api && bun install && cd ../ui && bun install
scripts.setup:db: docker compose up -d && cd packages/api && bun run drizzle-kit generate && bun run drizzle-kit push
scripts.build: cd packages/api && bun run build && cd ../ui && bun run build
